pages.title: Cheshire Cat Sitting with His Striped Tail Curled Around His Paws Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows the Cheshire Cat sitting with his striped tail curled around his paws, a tilted head, and an enormous toothy grin. Broad bands divide his body and tail into open sections, while whiskers, pointed ears, and small toes add finer details to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cheshire Cat Reclining Across a Leafy Tree Branch with His Chin Resting on His Forepaws Coloring Page
pages.description: The Cheshire Cat reclines across a leafy tree branch in this printable coloring page, resting his chin on his forepaws beneath his high, curved tail. Veined leaves frame his striped body, and long bark lines cross the branch. This coloring sheet combines large curved bands with smaller facial and foliage details.

pages.title: Cheshire Cat Balancing on the Tip of His Curled Tail Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features the Cheshire Cat balancing on the tip of his curled tail, with his paws gathered beneath his grinning, round face. Loose spirals and small circles surround the suspended pose. The coloring sheet leaves generous white space around broad body shapes and the tail's curved stripes.

pages.title: Cheshire Cat Tossing His Grinning Head Above His Forepaws Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features the Cheshire Cat with his grinning head tilted above his raised forepaws, showing pointed ears, long whiskers, and small claws. Curved stripes divide his shoulders and arms, while his wide toothy smile creates a row of narrow sections. The coloring sheet leaves broad open areas across his belly and around the close-up pose.

pages.title: Cheshire Cat Standing on His Head as Alice Watches in the Forest Coloring Page
pages.description: The Cheshire Cat stands on his head as Alice watches in this printable coloring page, his striped body inverted and his tail curling toward an overhead branch. Alice's bow, apron, and outstretched hand contrast with his broad grin. Large forest shapes and the cat's curved stripes give this coloring sheet clearly separated areas.

pages.title: Cheshire Cat Singing From a Tree Branch in Tulgey Wood Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows the Cheshire Cat singing from a branch in Tulgey Wood, with an open mouth, raised paw, and tall curling tail. A tree trunk and rounded foliage surround his striped body. The coloring sheet pairs wide bands on the cat with narrow bark contours and small facial details.

pages.title: Cheshire Cat Disappearing Tail First While Alice Watches Beneath His Tree Coloring Page
pages.description: The Cheshire Cat disappears tail first while Alice watches beneath his tree in this printable coloring page, with curved wisps breaking apart his striped silhouette. His grinning face and folded forepaws remain on the branch above her. Flowers, leaves, and Alice's apron add distinct smaller shapes throughout the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cheshire Cat's Floating Grin Lingering Between the Leaves of an Empty Tree Branch Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page captures the Cheshire Cat's floating grin between leafy branches, with pointed ears, long whiskers, and wide eyes above his enormous smile. His body is absent from the open center. Veined leaves and knots in the tree provide smaller details around the face on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cheshire Cat Pointing Alice Toward the Mad Hatter and the March Hare at a Fork in the Forest Path Coloring Page
pages.description: The Cheshire Cat points Alice toward the Mad Hatter and March Hare in this printable coloring page, beside a fork in the winding forest path. A small tea table with cups stands between the distant pair. The coloring sheet contrasts the cat's broad stripes with Alice's apron, scattered flowers, and large tree canopies.

pages.title: Cheshire Cat Reappearing to Ask Alice About the Baby That Turned Into a Pig Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows the Cheshire Cat reappearing above Alice as she holds the baby turned pig, bundled in a blanket beneath his branch. The cat rests his forepaws together beside his looping striped tail. Alice's surprised expression, headband bow, and the pig's snout add small focal details to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cheshire Cat Grinning Beside the Duchess's Kitchen Hearth While the Cook Stirs Peppery Soup Coloring Page
pages.description: The Cheshire Cat grins beside the Duchess's kitchen hearth in this printable coloring page, while the cook stirs peppery soup in a large steaming pot. Hanging utensils and stacked hearth bricks surround the scene. His upright striped tail and rounded paws provide broad coloring areas beside the kitchen's smaller details on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cheshire Cat's Floating Head Talking to Alice as She Holds a Flamingo on the Croquet Lawn Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows the Cheshire Cat's floating head talking to Alice as she holds a flamingo beside croquet hoops on a gently sloping lawn. His wide grin hangs above the bird's curved neck. The coloring sheet keeps the background open, with Alice's apron, the flamingo's wing, and facial features supplying smaller sections.

pages.title: Cheshire Cat Turning Away From the King of Hearts as He Offers His Hand Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows the Cheshire Cat turning away from the King of Hearts, who extends one hand while holding a heart-topped royal staff. The cat folds his forelegs and looks aside beneath an upright tail. Heart motifs, garden roses, and shaped hedges add repeated details around the figures on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cheshire Cat's Bodiless Head Hovering Above the Queen of Hearts and the Puzzled Executioner Coloring Page
pages.description: The Cheshire Cat's bodiless head hovers above the Queen of Hearts and a puzzled executioner in this printable coloring page, framed by a stone archway. Spiral eyes and pointed teeth emphasize his floating face. The executioner scratches his hood while carrying an axe, and the queen's heart-patterned dress supplies smaller sections on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cheshire Cat Emerging From an Open Storybook with a Tree and Mushrooms Rising From Its Pages Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts the Cheshire Cat emerging from an open storybook, with a twisting tree and spotted mushrooms rising from its wide pages. One large paw reaches forward as his striped tail curves overhead. The coloring sheet mixes broad page shapes and body stripes with mushroom gills, leaves, and fine facial lines.

pages.title: Cheshire Cat Showing Alice a Secret Doorway in a Tree Leading to the Queen of Hearts's Garden Coloring Page
pages.description: The Cheshire Cat shows Alice a secret doorway in a tree in this printable coloring page, revealing the Queen of Hearts's garden beyond the opening. Heart-shaped hedges and distant castle towers appear through the arched entrance. His pointing paw, striped tail, and Alice's wide apron give this coloring sheet varied large and small areas.

pages.title: Cheshire Cat Standing on the Back of the Queen of Hearts's Skirt During the Croquet Game Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows the Cheshire Cat standing on the back of the Queen of Hearts's skirt as she prepares a croquet stroke nearby. A hedgehog waits beside her mallet and a low hoop. The cat's stripes, the queen's heart-patterned train, and a distant castle add separate decorative areas to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cheshire Cat Peering Over a Glass Table Set with a Drink Me Bottle and an Eat Me Cake Coloring Page
pages.description: The Cheshire Cat peers over a glass table in this printable coloring page, studying a Drink Me bottle and an Eat Me cake beneath his grin. The bottle has a tied label, while icing and a cherry top the cake. Curled table legs and broad tail stripes add contrasting shapes to this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cheshire Cat Appearing at Alice's Trial and Startling the Dormouse Beside the Mad Hatter Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows the Cheshire Cat appearing at Alice's trial and startling the Dormouse beside the Mad Hatter, whose hands grip a table. The Dormouse springs from an open teapot beneath the cat's floating grin. Tall courtroom furniture and the Hatter's hat frame the smaller facial details on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cheshire Cat Whispering to the Queen of Hearts While Alice Stands Nearby Coloring Page
pages.description: The Cheshire Cat whispers beside the Queen of Hearts's ear in this printable coloring page, while Alice stands nearby looking upward beneath her headband bow. His crouched striped body extends behind the queen's high collar. A heart-shaped staff, geometric skirt panels, and small mushrooms provide distinct details across this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Tim Burton's Cheshire Cat Looking at the Scratches on Alice's Arm During Their First Forest Meeting Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Tim Burton's Cheshire Cat examining scratches on Alice's arm during their first forest meeting, perched on a curling tree branch. Alice points toward the marks while his striped tail arches behind him. Twisted bark, scattered leaves, and the cat's pointed teeth add fine details to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Tim Burton's Cheshire Cat Waiting Ahead of Alice on the Winding Path to the Mad Hatter's Tea Party Coloring Page
pages.description: Tim Burton's Cheshire Cat waits ahead of Alice on a winding forest path in this printable coloring page, above the route to the Mad Hatter's tea party. A distant table and tall hat mark the destination. Spotted mushrooms border the stepping stones, adding small patterned sections beneath the cat's broad stripes on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Tim Burton's Cheshire Cat Sitting at the End of the Mad Hatter's Crowded Tea Table Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Tim Burton's Cheshire Cat sitting at the end of the Mad Hatter's crowded tea table, resting his face between raised paws. Stacked cups, saucers, a teapot, and a layered cake fill the foreground. His broad tail stripes contrast with the crockery's narrow rims and scalloped patterns on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Tim Burton's Cheshire Cat Disappearing as the Red Queen's Soldiers Approach the Tea Party Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Tim Burton's Cheshire Cat disappearing as the Red Queen's soldiers approach the tea party, his striped body breaking into curling wisps. Two heart-armored guards carry long spears beneath the trees. Cups, saucers, and a teapot remain on the foreground table, giving this coloring sheet several distinct groups of shapes.

pages.title: Tim Burton's Cheshire Cat Visiting the Mad Hatter Inside a Barred Castle Cell Coloring Page
pages.description: Tim Burton's Cheshire Cat visits the Mad Hatter at a barred castle cell in this printable coloring page, looking up toward the prisoner's worried face. The Hatter grips the bars beneath his tall, banded hat. Fine fur edges, patterned cuffs, masonry blocks, and floor tiles add smaller sections around the figures on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Tim Burton's Cheshire Cat Floating Above the Castle Courtyard Wearing the Mad Hatter's Top Hat Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Tim Burton's Cheshire Cat floating above a castle courtyard, wearing the Mad Hatter's oversized top hat above his pointed ears. His paws gather beneath a wide grin while his tail curls upward. Arched walkways, slender towers, and a central fountain provide architectural details below him on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Tim Burton's Cheshire Cat Returning the Top Hat to the Mad Hatter Beside Alice Coloring Page
pages.description: Tim Burton's Cheshire Cat returns a top hat to the Mad Hatter in this printable coloring page, floating above Alice beside a tea table with cups. The seated Hatter crosses his legs beneath a patterned jacket and large bow tie. Broad skirt panels and the cat's curved stripes balance the smaller crockery details on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Tim Burton's Cheshire Cat Volunteering Before the White Queen Alongside the Mad Hatter and White Rabbit Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Tim Burton's Cheshire Cat volunteering before the White Queen alongside the Mad Hatter and White Rabbit, gathered beneath a tall arch. The queen sits on a high-backed throne while the rabbit holds his pocket watch. The cat's curled tail, crown points, and suit details give this coloring sheet varied enclosed shapes.

pages.title: Tim Burton's Cheshire Cat Placing the Recovered Crown on the White Queen's Head Coloring Page
pages.description: Tim Burton's Cheshire Cat places the recovered crown on the White Queen's head in this printable coloring page, balancing behind her chair with both forepaws raised. The queen looks upward beneath wavy hair and a beaded necklace. Ornate crown curls and fine fur contrast with her sweeping gown's broad folds on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Tim Burton's Cheshire Cat Watching the Mad Hatter's Futterwacken Dance with Alice Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Tim Burton's Cheshire Cat watching the Mad Hatter's Futterwacken dance with Alice, crouched on a curling branch above the dancers. The Hatter lifts one knee beneath his tall hat as Alice's patterned skirt flares. Spotted mushrooms and loose spirals surround the striped cat and moving figures on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Tim Burton's Cheshire Cat Bidding Alice Farewell with the White Queen and the March Hare Coloring Page
pages.description: Tim Burton's Cheshire Cat bids Alice farewell in this printable coloring page, floating above the White Queen and March Hare with one paw raised in greeting. Alice waves back beside the queen's layered gown, while the hare holds a cup. Flowers and curling branches add decorative details around the group on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cheshire Cat Curled Asleep Inside a Hollow Tree Surrounded By Woodland Mushrooms Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows the Cheshire Cat curled asleep inside a hollow tree, resting his head on his forepaws above a bed of leaves. His thick striped tail loops across the foreground. Spotted woodland mushrooms, bark grooves, and overlapping leaves surround the large curved body sections on this detailed coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cheshire Cat Climbing a Twisting Tree Trunk Above a Winding Forest Path Coloring Page
pages.description: The Cheshire Cat climbs a twisting tree trunk above a winding forest path in this printable coloring page, gripping the bark with his widely spaced paws. His raised striped tail curves away from the trunk. Tall trees and rounded bushes border the distant path, creating smaller landscape sections behind the cat on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cheshire Cat Crossing Stepping Stones in a Mushroom-lined Woodland Stream Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts the Cheshire Cat crossing stepping stones in a woodland stream, reaching one broad paw forward beneath his high, curling striped tail. Spotted mushrooms line the banks between leafy plants and rocks. Water ripples and narrow grass shapes add fine details around the large stones on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cheshire Cat Perched on a Giant Spotted Mushroom Beneath Arching Fern Leaves Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows the Cheshire Cat perched on a giant spotted mushroom beneath arching fern leaves, with his forepaws resting along the cap. His thick striped tail rises behind a broad grin. The coloring sheet contrasts large oval spots and sweeping body bands with narrow mushroom gills and repeated fern leaflets.

pages.title: Cheshire Cat Lounging on a Crescent Moon Surrounded By Stars and Small Clouds Coloring Page
pages.description: The Cheshire Cat lounges on a crescent moon in this printable coloring page, surrounded by small clouds and scattered stars against an otherwise open sky. He folds his paws beneath his chin while his striped tail lifts upward. Broad moon and body sections make this coloring sheet simpler than scenes filled with detailed scenery.

pages.title: Cheshire Cat Peeking Out of an Oversized Floral Teacup with His Tail Curled Around the Saucer Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features the Cheshire Cat peeking from an oversized floral teacup, gripping the rim while his striped tail curls around the saucer. Large daisylike flowers and pointed leaves decorate the cup. The coloring sheet combines generous petal shapes and tail bands with smaller whiskers, toes, and narrow curved crockery rims.

pages.title: Cheshire Cat's Face Appearing in the Steam Curling From a Wonderland Teapot Coloring Page
pages.description: The Cheshire Cat's face appears in curling teapot steam in this printable coloring page, with wide eyes and a toothy grin suspended above the lid. Sweeping scroll patterns decorate the rounded Wonderland teapot. Long steam ribbons provide open curved sections, while ornamental curls and facial lines add finer details to this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cheshire Cat Floating Among Tumbling Playing Cards Above a Checkerboard Floor Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows the Cheshire Cat floating among tumbling playing cards above a checkerboard floor, stretching his forepaws forward beneath his striped body. Hearts, clubs, spades, and diamonds fill the surrounding cards. The coloring sheet offers broad curved stripes alongside angular card borders and floor squares that narrow into the distance.

pages.title: Cheshire Cat Curled Around a Giant Pocket Watch with Its Chain Looping Between Mushrooms Coloring Page
pages.description: The Cheshire Cat curls around a giant pocket watch in this printable coloring page, resting his forepaws above its face as the chain loops between mushrooms. His striped tail wraps beneath the round case. Linked chain sections, pointed clock hands, spotted caps, and mushroom gills create smaller details around the broad shapes on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cheshire Cat Sitting Atop a Heart-shaped Hedge in the Queen of Hearts's Garden Maze Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows the Cheshire Cat sitting atop a heart-shaped hedge in the Queen of Hearts's garden maze, with his striped tail draped forward. Roses and small hearts decorate the surrounding hedges. The coloring sheet leaves a large open area inside the central topiary, bordered by winding paths and smaller flower shapes.

pages.title: Cheshire Cat Peeking Through the Keyhole of a Giant Rose-covered Garden Door Coloring Page
pages.description: The Cheshire Cat peeks through a giant garden door's keyhole in this printable coloring page, his grinning face and one striped foreleg filling the opening. Rose vines climb the door's vertical boards around an ornamental lock plate. Petal layers, serrated leaves, round fasteners, and curled hinges add detailed sections to this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cheshire Cat Watching Card Gardeners Paint a Rosebush Beside the Queen of Hearts's Palace Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows the Cheshire Cat watching card gardeners paint a rosebush beside the Queen of Hearts's palace, resting on a branch overhead. Two gardeners hold brushes and dripping paint buckets below his dangling tail. The coloring sheet includes layered rose petals, suit symbols, and heart-topped palace towers around the main figures.

pages.title: Cheshire Cat Watching a Hedgehog Roll Beneath a Playing-card Croquet Arch Coloring Page
pages.description: The Cheshire Cat watches a hedgehog roll beneath a playing-card croquet arch in this printable coloring page, crouching on a branch above the woodland game. Curved motion lines surround the hedgehog's curled body. Suit symbols, spotted mushrooms, small flowers, and the cat's wide stripes give this coloring sheet a mix of patterned and open areas.

pages.title: Cheshire Cat's Grinning Face Surrounded By a Circular Arrangement of Roses, Teacups, Mushrooms, and Playing Cards Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page centers the Cheshire Cat's grinning face inside a circular arrangement of roses, teacups, mushrooms, and playing cards, leaving open space around him. Patterned cup bands and mushroom spots repeat among layered petals and leaves. The coloring sheet combines a large central face with many smaller decorative sections around its ring.

pages.title: Cheshire Cat Floating Above Alice in a Wonderland Labyrinth of Giant Mushrooms and Melting Clocks Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows the Cheshire Cat above Alice in a Wonderland labyrinth, surrounded by giant mushrooms, melting clocks, and curling tree branches overhead. Alice stands on a narrow, winding path and looks toward his grin. Spotted caps, striped stems, and drooping clock faces create many distinct patterned sections on this detailed coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cheshire Cat's Floating Eyes and Grin Above the Words We're All Mad Here Inside a Curling Striped Tail Frame Coloring Page
pages.description: The Cheshire Cat's floating eyes and grin appear above We're All Mad Here in this printable coloring page, enclosed by a curling striped tail frame. Outlined lettering fills two lines beneath the sharp-toothed smile. Small stars, dots, and spirals add details between the broad tail bands and large open letters on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cheshire Cat Facing His Reflection in an Ornate Looking Glass Surrounded By Roses Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts the Cheshire Cat facing his reflection in an ornate looking glass surrounded by roses, his raised tail curving beside the frame. The reflected cat looks outward with a wide grin and paired forepaws. Layered petals and narrow frame scrolls contrast with the broad striped body sections on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cheshire Cat Studying a Map of Wonderland Showing the Forest Crossroads, Tea Party, and Queen of Hearts's Castle Coloring Page
pages.description: The Cheshire Cat studies a map of Wonderland in this printable coloring page, showing forest crossroads, a tea party, and the Queen of Hearts's castle. His paws hold the curled map open beneath a tree branch. A dotted route, tiny signposts, and a decorative compass add smaller shapes to this coloring sheet's large scroll.

pages.title: Cheshire Cat Sitting Beside a Grinning Jack-o'-lantern While Alice Holds a Pumpkin Bucket Under a Crescent Moon Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows the Cheshire Cat beside a grinning jack-o'-lantern while Alice holds a pumpkin bucket beneath a crescent moon and scattered stars. His striped tail curls around his seated paws. Large pumpkin segments, Alice's apron, and open sky areas make the coloring sheet spacious, with smaller teeth and star shapes for detail.

pages.title: Alice in Wonderland Cheshire Cat in Rabbit Hole Coloring Page
pages.description: The Cheshire Cat rests inside a rabbit hole in this printable coloring page, folding his forepaws beneath a broad grin as his striped tail curls forward. Roots and long curved wall lines follow the tunnel toward a small leafy opening. The coloring sheet places broad body stripes within narrower, flowing sections of the surrounding hollow.

pages.title: Alice in Wonderland Cheshire Cat in Enchanted Library Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows the Cheshire Cat in an enchanted library, sitting behind an open book with a quill and candle on the table. Tall bookshelves recede beneath arched ceilings and hanging lanterns. His wide striped body provides large areas beside the repeated book spines and narrow architectural lines on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Alice in Wonderland Cheshire Cat in Hallway of Doors Coloring Page
pages.description: The Cheshire Cat sits in a hallway of doors in this printable coloring page, with his striped tail curled around his paws and his face grinning forward. Paneled doors line both walls and the far end. Long floorboard lines lead behind him, giving this coloring sheet broad geometric sections around the cat's curved markings.

pages.title: Alice in Wonderland Cheshire Cat in Wonderland Garden Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows the Cheshire Cat perched on a branch in a Wonderland garden, surrounded by roses, leafy twigs, mushrooms, and a large flower. His striped tail hangs below the branch as his broad grin faces forward. The coloring sheet pairs simple petal and mushroom shapes with smaller whiskers and pointed leaf sections.

pages.title: Alice in Wonderland Cheshire Cat in Starlight Garden Coloring Page
pages.description: The Cheshire Cat sits in a starlight garden in this printable coloring page, his curled striped tail framed by tall plants, flowers, and a small crescent moon. Outlined stars and little sparkles scatter above his pointed ears. Broad body sections balance the finer stems, petals, and curling vines around this coloring sheet's central figure.

pages.title: Alice in Wonderland Cheshire Cat in Hedge Maze Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features the Cheshire Cat sitting inside a hedge maze, with his striped tail curled beside his forepaws and his wide eyes facing forward. Squared hedge turns recede behind his pointed ears. Scattered leaves break up the broad hedge shapes, adding small repeated sections around the cat on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Alice in Wonderland Cheshire Cat in Castle Courtyard Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows the Cheshire Cat sitting on a low wall in a castle courtyard, with his striped tail hanging over the stonework. Rounded towers and an arched gateway rise behind the surrounding plants. The coloring sheet mixes broad body markings and paving stones with smaller leaves, brick details, and narrow castle windows.

pages.title: Alice in Wonderland Cheshire Cat in Mushroom Forest Coloring Page
pages.description: The Cheshire Cat sits on a broad spotted cap in this printable coloring page, grinning among the smaller mushrooms and rounded trees of a mushroom forest. His forepaws meet beneath a striped chest and tufted cheeks. Large spots and body bands provide open sections, with narrower gills and leaves adding details to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Alice in Wonderland Cheshire Cat in White Rabbit's Garden Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page places the Cheshire Cat in the White Rabbit's garden, seated beside a winding path among flowers, mushrooms, and short picket fences. A small cottage with a thatched roof stands behind him. The coloring sheet combines the cat's broad stripes with repeated petals, pointed leaves, and simple window panels.

pages.title: Alice in Wonderland Cheshire Cat on Caterpillar's Mushroom Coloring Page
pages.description: The Cheshire Cat rests on the Caterpillar's mushroom in this printable coloring page, folding his forepaws over the spotted cap as his striped tail curls forward. Radiating gills sit beneath the cap above a wide stem. Leafy plants and grass surround the base, adding smaller sections beside the broad mushroom and body shapes on this coloring sheet.
